title: A Survey on Responsible Generative AI: What to Generate and What Not
findings: This survey paper notes that a key requirement for responsible generative AI is to avoid generating toxic content. It highlights that one form of such toxic content is social biases, which can include stereotypes based on religion. The paper cites existing research demonstrating that Large Language Models can associate Muslims with violence.
